channel.title: Peninsula Insider
channel.description: Editorial coverage of the Mornington Peninsula - eat, stay, do, wine, and the weekend curated.

item.title: Two Bays on tap, waratahs on the Bushrangers Bay track, and the VineHop Festival this Saturday
item.description: A gluten-free pale ale that holds up without the qualifier at Two Bays in Dromana, waratah season on the Bushrangers Bay Walk near Flinders, and what to know before Saturday's Peninsula VineHop Festival.

item.title: Lindenderry's garden walk, the NWOP's final weekend, and live music at Fingal
item.description: Red Hill estate gardens at their spring peak, the National Works on Paper closing Sunday at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery, and acoustic sets at Peppers Moonah Links in Fingal.

item.title: Main Ridge Dairy, the Arthurs Seat wildflower loop, and the NWOP's last weekend
item.description: Goat-milk gelato at a working farmgate, spring orchids on the Arthurs Seat Eagle trail network, and the National Works on Paper exhibition closing Sunday at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery.

item.title: Three verified Peninsula stops: Moorooduc, Bushrangers Bay and Nazaaray
item.description: Current practical information from the operators and Parks Victoria for a winery visit, a Cape Schanck walk and a Flinders cellar door.

item.title: Casual Lunch on the Mornington Peninsula: Where to Eat Well Without Making a Day of It
item.description: Not every Peninsula lunch needs a degustation and four hours. The places that do a relaxed, good midday meal, sorted by where you will be and who you are with.

item.title: Date Night on the Mornington Peninsula: Where to Book for Two
item.description: A sunset drink, a room worth dressing for and no long drive home. The Peninsula's best dinners for two, from a Sri Lankan wine bar on the ridge to a set menu in Flinders, and how to build the evening around them.

item.title: Barragunda Dining and the Bushrangers Bay Walk
item.description: Verified practical information for a Cape Schanck meal and the Bushrangers Bay Walk.

item.title: The Mornington Peninsula in Summer: How to Do It Well
item.description: Long light, warm bay water and the busiest roads of the year. A local's plan for summer on the Peninsula: which side to swim, when to move, what to book and what to leave loose.

item.title: Summer School Holidays on the Mornington Peninsula, 2026-27
item.description: Six weeks, one Peninsula and a car full of children. The calm beaches, the outings worth the drive, the rainy-day backups and the timing that keeps the whole thing pleasant, from 19 December to late January.

item.title: St Andrews Beach Brewery, the Cape Schanck heathland, and the Mt Eliza Farmers Market
item.description: A Sunday roast in a converted racehorse stable, spring wildflowers at their densest on the Bushranger Bay heathland trail, and the last Saturday of the Mt Eliza market run.

item.title: Portsea Hotel fish and chips, the Bushranger Bay snorkel trail, and live music at Moonah Links
item.description: The Portsea Hotel's front-beach deck before the summer crowds, the Bushranger Bay underwater trail at peak spring visibility, and acoustic sets running every Saturday at Peppers Moonah Links through December.

item.title: Somers General, the Mornington inlet run, and an acoustic set at Moonah Links
item.description: Somers General's Sunday brunch spread, the Balcombe Creek estuary walk at high tide, and live music on the Moonah Links deck before the summer crowds land.

item.title: Baillieu Vineyard, the Merricks vine walk, and National Works on Paper closing soon
item.description: Baillieu Vineyard's Chardonnay opens up with time, the Merricks vine walk is at its best in new-growth spring, and the National Works on Paper show at MPRG closes 22 November.

item.title: Green Olive in the grove, the coastal heath in full flower, and the Works on Paper closing window
item.description: Green Olive at Red Hill's wood-fired lamb under the olive grove, the Boneo heathland orchids at peak density, and the National Works on Paper show at MPRG closing 22 November.

item.title: Red Hill Brewery's tasting paddle, the Boneo Plains wildflower flush, and the Mt Eliza Farmers Market
item.description: Red Hill Brewery's Belgian-style paddle in the hop yard, the grassland orchid bloom on Boneo Plains, and the Mt Eliza Farmers Market running until 22 November.

item.title: Rye Hotel's deck in spring, the Cape Schanck heathland walk, and Elan Vineyard's current show
item.description: The Rye Hotel earns a long afternoon on its foreshore deck, Cape Schanck's heathland boardwalk hits peak colour this week, and Elan Vineyard & Gallery in Balnarring is showing new work worth the detour.

item.title: Balnarring Bakehouse, Greens Bush in Flower, and Emu Plains Market
item.description: Balnarring Bakehouse's beef-and-mushroom pie, Greens Bush at peak wildflower density, and the Emu Plains Market at Balnarring Reserve on Saturday.

item.title: Avani's Syrah, Western Port Wildflowers, and the Emu Plains Market in Full Spring
item.description: Avani Wines pours the skin-contact white that earns a detour, the coastal scrub above Balnarring is carpeted in wax lip orchids, and the Emu Plains Market at Balnarring Reserve runs until mid-December.

item.title: Moke's five-course set menu, the Balnarring horse trails at peak spring green, and the Emu Plains Market craft find
item.description: Moke Dining's fixed five-course menu in Flinders, the Balnarring horse trails at their most open, and the Emu Plains Market in Balnarring for a local's Saturday circuit.

item.title: The Bay Hotel's vault room, Greens Bush in flower, and Wine and Cheese Night in Hastings
item.description: The Bay Hotel Mornington's private vault dining room earns a booking, Greens Bush trails are at peak wildflower density, and Wine Lovers Warehouse Hastings runs a guided cheese-and-glass night on Friday.

item.title: Commonfolk Coffee, Cape Schanck Boardwalk, and Wine and Cheese Night at Hastings
item.description: Commonfolk's roastery brunch earns a Mornington morning, the Cape Schanck boardwalk is at its coastal heath peak, and Wine Lovers Warehouse runs a Friday-night pour in Hastings.

item.title: Eldridge Estate, Boneo Road Wildflowers, and National Works on Paper 2026
item.description: David Lloyd's MV6 Pinot Noir at Eldridge Estate, the coastal heath in full flower along Boneo Road's Greens Bush loop, and the National Works on Paper 2026 closing at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery on 22 November.

item.title: Rare Hare's terrace, the Enchanted Adventure Garden maze, and Emu Plains Market at Balnarring
item.description: Rare Hare at Willow Creek opens its Pinot Row terrace for spring, the Enchanted Adventure Garden's hedge maze hits peak season, and Emu Plains Market runs Saturdays at Balnarring Reserve through December.

item.title: Jetty Road Brewery's seasonal taps, Arthurs Seat in spring bloom, and the National Works on Paper closing run
item.description: Jetty Road Brewery's rotating seasonals earn the afternoon, Arthurs Seat State Park is at peak wildflower density, and the National Works on Paper 2026 closes 22 November at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery.

item.title: Quarters at Flinders, the Bushrangers Bay track, and the Emu Plains Market at Balnarring
item.description: Flinders Hotel's pub dining earns a spring Saturday booking, Bushrangers Bay track is in full coastal heath bloom, and the Emu Plains Market at Balnarring Reserve is quietly one of the Peninsula's best Saturday rituals.

item.title: Flinders Sourdough, the Wirrbul Loop, and the Bloody Long Walk at Portsea
item.description: A wood-fired Beach Bun in Flinders, the Wirrbul walking trail in full spring wattle, and Sunday's Bloody Long Walk starting from the Quarantine Station at Portsea.

item.title: Foxeys Hangout, the Coastal Cliffs at Cape Schanck, and British Comedy Trivia in Main Ridge
item.description: Foxeys Hangout's biodynamic sparkling flight earns the afternoon, Cape Schanck's clifftop track is in full spring form, and The Pig & Whistle is running British Comedy Trivia tonight.

item.title: Merricks lunch, the Boneo Plains grassland, and a new opening in Dromana
item.description: Merricks General Wine Store earns a dedicated spring lunch booking, the Boneo Plains Native Grassland Reserve is at peak golden weather-grass, and The Curious Pantry has opened its doors in Dromana.

item.title: Two Bays on the taps, spider orchids above Balnarring, and what's showing at McClelland this spring
item.description: Gluten-free or not, Two Bays Brewing's tasting paddle in Dromana earns a full second pour; the Balnarring wildflower loop hits peak spider orchid; and McClelland Sculpture Park's spring outdoor exhibition runs through November.

item.title: Lindenderry's spring garden table, the Boneo Plains wildflower loop, and Emu Plains Market in Balnarring
item.description: Lindenderry's estate dining room in full bloom, the Boneo Plains grassland loop for spider orchids this week, and the Emu Plains Market at Balnarring Reserve on Saturday.

item.title: Main Ridge Dairy Cheese Board, the Bloodroot Track in Spring Colour, and British Comedy Trivia at The Pig & Whistle
item.description: Goat-milk gelato at Main Ridge Dairy, wildflower season along the Bloodroot Track above Merricks, and a British Comedy Trivia night at The Pig & Whistle on Thursday.

item.title: Kooyong's single-block spring flight, Baldry's Creek wildflowers, and the Pig & Whistle's British Comedy Trivia
item.description: Kooyong's named-block Pinot tasting in Red Hill South, the Balnarring wildflower loop at Baldry's Creek Reserve, and a Main Ridge pub quiz built around Blackadder and Fawlty Towers on Thursday night.

item.title: Barragunda's Market Garden Menu, the Breast Foot Forward Walk, and an Orizome Workshop at MPRG
item.description: Barragunda Dining's estate set menu at Cape Schanck, the Breast Foot Forward coastal walk from Safety Beach on Saturday, and a free orizome paper-dyeing workshop at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery.

item.title: Steinfest at Tar Barrel, the Arthurs Seat Summit Track, and a free fishing lesson at Mornington Pier
item.description: Tar Barrel's Steinfest runs until Sunday, the Arthurs Seat Summit Track is in full spring form, and a free come-and-try fishing session opens on Friday morning at Mornington Pier.

item.title: Portsea pub fish and chips and the Baldry's Creek loop
item.description: The Portsea Hotel's Port Phillip views with fish and chips and a spring wildflower loop at Baldry's Creek Reserve.

item.title: Somers General on a Spring Sunday, the Bushrangers Bay Cliff Loop, and National Works on Paper at MPRG
item.description: A Western Port brunch stop with Peninsula pantry goods, a coastal trail above Flinders at peak wildflower, and a national paper art survey open until 22 November at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery.

item.title: Baillieu Vineyard, Cape Schanck Coastal Track, and Main Street Mornington Festival
item.description: Baillieu's Merricks Chardonnay at a cellar door most weekenders miss, the Cape Schanck coastal loop with spring wildflowers on the cliffs, and the Main Street Mornington Festival running free on Sunday.

item.title: Wood-fired lamb at Red Hill, wattle on the Boardwalk Loop, and origami at the regional gallery
item.description: Green Olive at Red Hill's grove-to-table spring Sunday, the Boardwalk Nature Circuit at peak wattle bloom, and a free orizome paper-dyeing workshop at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery this Saturday.

item.title: St Andrews Beach Brewery, the Bushrangers Bay Track, and the Breast Foot Forward Walk
item.description: A Sunday roast at the old stables brewery in Fingal, the Bushrangers Bay coastal loop in full spring flower, and a community walk from Safety Beach to Martha Cove on Saturday.

item.title: Jackalope in spring, Cape Woolamai from the ridge, and live wrestling for a good cause
item.description: Doot Doot Doot's vineyard dining in Merricks North, the Cape Woolamai ridge walk at peak wattle, and Dominion Wrestling's charity bout at Commonfolk on Friday night.
